observations.explanation: The paper describes four self-hosted applications populated with sampled real-world data, multiple observation modes, utility tools, and knowledge resources (PDF pp. 2–5). It also states that standalone hosting avoids reliance on live websites for reproducibility (PDF p. 3).
The paper says its functional-correctness evaluation checks whether the result achieves the goal and accommodates multiple valid paths, rather than comparing action sequences (PDF p. 2).

The benchmark uses selected applications and sampled content, and the appendix explicitly says the map is confined to the northeastern United States because of data-storage constraints (PDF pp. 3, 16).

The reported baselines are text-based LLM agents using accessibility-tree observations and element-ID actions, with GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 (PDF p. 9). The authors identify image-based observations and pixel-based actions as future work, so these results do not establish performance for other model classes or modalities (PDF p. 9).
